description:
FILES: extensions/tools.ex, test/octo_pi/coder/extensions/tools_test.exs

REQUIRES: opi-fin.2.2, opi-fin.2.3

Tools is stateful with enabled_tools MapSet. It also uses API.bind_core for get_all_tools, get_active_tools, set_active_tools, append_entry.

MIGRATION:
1. Add 'use OctoPi.Coder.Extension'.
2. Remove def init(api, state). Macro generates init/1.
3. Add def mount, do: {:ok, %{enabled_tools: MapSet.new()}} -- initial state. The actual enabled tools are loaded in handle_session_start.
4. Convert session_start, session_tree handlers to 3-arity callbacks. The enabled_tools MapSet becomes part of state, not a closed-over Agent.
5. The /tools command handler also needs access to state -- if it reads enabled_tools, it must receive state too. If commands are registered differently from event handlers, evaluate how command handlers receive state. Commands currently receive (args, ctx) -- may need to close over state_agent if the macro doesn't handle command state threading. Document whatever approach is taken.

IMPORTANT: DO NOT remove API.bind_core usage for get_all_tools, get_active_tools, set_active_tools, append_entry. That is Phase 6.

TEST: tools_test.exs -- remove outer Agent.start_link for state. Keep bind_core injections for action fns.
title: Migrate Tools to mount/0 pattern
